note: Bind values as parameters; never format SQL strings.
Use $1/? placeholders and pass values separately.
Use bindings (?) instead of concatenation.
Encode output for the HTML context.
Escape (or return JSON) before writing user input to the response.
Use textContent; sanitize (DOMPurify) if HTML is required.
Pass an argument list, no shell, and validate the input.
Use a data-only format and validate it.
Use a slow password hash (argon2id/bcrypt).
Load the signing secret from the environment and pin the algorithm.
Read secrets from the environment / a secret manager.
Keep certificate verification on; add the CA bundle if needed.
Resolve the path and verify it stays inside the base directory.
Use an allowlist of destinations; never fetch a user-supplied URL.
Look the record up through the current user.
List only your own origins.
Describe meaningful images (or alt="" if decorative).
Checks-effects-interactions + nonReentrant.
Integer minor units (cents) or Decimal.
Verify the provider signature over the RAW body.
Always scope by the authenticated tenant (and enforce with RLS).
Always await Playwright web-first assertions.
